shift = a period of work, for example morning or night
employer = a person or company that pays people to work
employee = a person who is paid to work for a company
colleague = a person you work with
well-paid = giving a lot of money for the work
stressful = causing a lot of worry or pressure
work from home = to do your job in your house, not in an office
retire = to stop working, usually because of age
skills = things you can do well because of practice or training
experience = knowledge you get by doing a job
nine-to-five = a typical full-time office day
vacancy = a job that is available
get a job = to be given paid work
earn = to receive money for work you do
do for a living = to have as your job
self-employed = working for yourself, not for a boss
doctor = a person trained to treat people who are ill
teacher = a person whose job is to teach in a school
farmer = a person who grows food or keeps animals on the land
pilot = a person who flies a plane
